acquisition method: A data-dependent acquisition (DDA) method was employed.

cleavage agent: 3 mg of HCT-116 cell proteins were digested into peptides with trypsin
collision energy: Top ten most abundant ions were sequentially isolated with a 2-m/z isolation window for fragmentation with 28% normalized collision energy.

fractionation method: The phosphopeptides were fractionated with online SCX-RPLC into 40 fractions

ionization type: 2.2 kV voltage was applied for electrospray ionization.

reduction concentration: reduction with 5 mM Dithiothreitol (DTT) at 37 °C for 1 h
